#!/bin/zsh

set -u

ROOT="/Users/Ori/Documents/Projects/BunkerGame"
RUNROOT="$ROOT/.opencode/overnight_world_v2"

export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:$HOME/.aftman/bin:$PATH"

CP="${1:-UNKNOWN}"
STATUS="${2:-INFO}"
shift 2 2>/dev/null || true
MESSAGE="$*"

TS="$(/bin/date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
SAFE_CP="$(printf '%s' "$CP" | /usr/bin/tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9._-')"

printf '%s|%s|%s|%s\n' \
  "$TS" \
  "$SAFE_CP" \
  "$STATUS" \
  "$MESSAGE" \
  >> "$RUNROOT/events.log"

printf '%s\n' "$SAFE_CP" > "$RUNROOT/current_checkpoint.txt"
printf '%s\n' "$MESSAGE" > "$RUNROOT/current_activity.txt"

if [ "$STATUS" = "START" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$SAFE_CP" > "$RUNROOT/state.txt"
fi

if [ "$STATUS" = "PASS" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$SAFE_CP" > "$RUNROOT/last_passed_checkpoint.txt"

  SNAP="$RUNROOT/checkpoints/${SAFE_CP}_$(/bin/date '+%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')"

  /bin/mkdir -p "$SNAP"

  if [ -d "$ROOT/src" ]; then
    /usr/bin/tar -czf "$SNAP/src.tar.gz" -C "$ROOT" src 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

  if [ -f "$ROOT/default.project.json" ]; then
    /bin/cp "$ROOT/default.project.json" "$SNAP/default.project.json" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

  if [ -f "$ROOT/opencode.json" ]; then
    /bin/cp "$ROOT/opencode.json" "$SNAP/opencode.json" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

  if [ -d "$ROOT/src/ServerStorage/GeneratedAssets" ]; then
    /usr/bin/find "$ROOT/src/ServerStorage/GeneratedAssets" \
      -type f \
      -print \
      | /usr/bin/sort \
      > "$SNAP/generated_assets.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

  /usr/bin/find "$ROOT/src" \
    -type f \
    -print \
    2>/dev/null \
    | /usr/bin/sort \
    > "$SNAP/source_files.txt" || true

  printf '%s\n' "$MESSAGE" > "$SNAP/checkpoint.txt"
  printf '%s\n' "$TS" >> "$SNAP/checkpoint.txt"
fi

printf 'CHECKPOINT|%s|%s|%s\n' "$SAFE_CP" "$STATUS" "$MESSAGE"

BUNKERGAME OVERNIGHT WORLD BUILD V2

You are the primary BunkerGame Art Director / orchestrator.

This is a REAL implementation run, not a planning exercise and not a proof-only exercise.

You must build a substantial playable world for BunkerGame overnight and continue autonomously until the required integrated checkpoints pass or a genuine unrecoverable blocker remains after five recovery attempts.

============================================================
MISSION
============================================================

Build a large, cohesive, creepy survival-world environment appropriate for BunkerGame.

The finished world should feel significantly larger, richer and more alive than the current prototype.

Use the existing approved assets and asset families wherever suitable.

Create additional assets only when existing approved assets are insufficient.

The world should include, where appropriate:

- substantial traversable terrain;
- hills and elevation variation;
- valleys, slopes and natural landforms;
- dense and sparse forest regions;
- believable tree distribution rather than uniform grids;
- rocks and boulder fields;
- natural landmarks;
- paths and navigational clearings;
- bunker/facility integration;
- meaningful spawn region;
- vegetation;
- environmental storytelling;
- distant ambient wildlife;
- animals moving in the background where technically practical;
- creepy atmospheric environmental motion;
- world ambience;
- lighting;
- fog/atmosphere;
- environmental audio;
- gameplay-relevant resource placement;
- scripts required for new systems;
- technical validation;
- controlled Play testing;
- debugging and fixes.

The result must remain a survival game world, not merely a visual demo.

============================================================
CANONICAL ORCHESTRATION
============================================================

The required orchestration is:

Muse / bunkergame-art-director
    ->
Qwen / bunkergame-master-reasoner
    ->
MiMo / bunker-builder
    ->
Roblox Studio native Assistant generation/composition
    +
BloxForge engineering validation
    ->
Muse visual review
    ->
filesystem/Rojo persistence
    ->
Studio verification
    ->
Play QA
    ->
final review

Never claim any participant was invoked unless it was actually invoked.

For reusable visual assets:

1. Search the approved Asset Library first.
2. Reuse existing approved assets/families when adequate.
3. Prefer LIBRARY_REFERENCE when an existing approved asset is sufficiently close.
4. Otherwise use USER_REFERENCE, QWEN_GENERATED_REFERENCE or ONLINE_REFERENCE when appropriate.
5. Roblox Assistant performs native creative generation/composition.
6. BloxForge performs engineering QA.
7. Muse performs visual review after visual evidence exists.
8. Only approved reusable assets are registered.
9. Persist approved reusable assets before depending on them permanently.

============================================================
CRITICAL SAFETY RULES
============================================================

DO NOT run `rojo serve`.

DO NOT start a live Rojo synchronization session.

DO NOT allow destructive Rojo reconciliation.

DO NOT use /tmp for evidence, state, generated prompts, builds or temporary project artifacts.

Do not stop at an intermediate phase. Stop only for a genuine human-only blocker
or when the complete rebuilt game and evidence package reach exactly

    if type(value) ~= "table" then

    for _, child in pairs(tableValue) do
        if type(child) == "table" and not table.isfrozen(child) then

    end
    table.freeze(tableValue)

local function buildIndex<T>(records: { T }): { [string]: T }
    local result: { [string]: T } = {}
    for _, record in ipairs(records) do
        local dynamicRecord = record :: any
        result[dynamicRecord.Id] = record
    end
    return result
end

local function cloneRecord<T>(record: T): T
    local result = {} :: any
    for key, value in pairs(record :: any) do
        result[key] = value
    end
    return result :: T
end

local function copyRecords<T>(records: { T }): { T }
    local result: { T } = {}
    for index, record in ipairs(records) do
        result[index] = cloneRecord(record)
    end
    return result
end

local function findAtPath(root: Instance, path: string): Instance?
    local current: Instance? = root
    for segment in string.gmatch(path, "[^%.]+") do
        if current == nil then
            return nil
        end
        current = current:FindFirstChild(segment)
    end
    return current
end

local function getPosition(instance: Instance): Vector3?
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        return instance.Position
    end
    if instance:IsA("Model") then
        return instance:GetPivot().Position
    end
    return nil
end

local function near(left: Vector3, right: Vector3): boolean
    return (left - right).Magnitude <= 0.05
end

local function validateManifest(): (boolean, { string })
    local errors: { string } = {}

    if #Spawns ~= Config.Server.MaxActivePlayers then
        table.insert(errors, "spawn count must equal maximum active players")
    end
    if #Plots ~= 12 or #Trees ~= 18 or #ScrapCaches ~= 6 or #Stations ~= 8 or #EnemySpawns ~= 7 then
        table.insert(errors, "one or more frozen world counts changed")
    end
    if StableGround.Position.Y + StableGround.Size.Y / 2 ~= StableGround.TopY then
        table.insert(errors, "stable ground top does not equal the world datum surface")
    end

    local paths: { [string]: boolean } = {}
    local function addRecords(records: { any }, idField: string)
        local ids: { [string]: boolean } = {}
        for _, record in ipairs(records) do
            if record.Id ~= record[idField] then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("manifest aliases disagree for %s", tostring(record.Id)))
            elseif ids[record[idField]] then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("duplicate manifest %s: %s", idField, record[idField]))
            end
            ids[record[idField]] = true
            if paths[record.Path] then
                table.insert(errors, "duplicate manifest path: " .. record.Path)
            end
            paths[record.Path] = true
        end
    end
    addRecords(Spawns, "SpawnId")
    addRecords(Stations, "InteractionId")
    addRecords(Plots, "PlotId")
    addRecords(ResourceNodes, "ResourceNodeId")
    addRecords(EnemySpawns, "SpawnId")
    addRecords(Objectives, "ObjectiveId")

    for _, enemySpawn in ipairs(EnemySpawns) do
        for _, playerSpawn in ipairs(Spawns) do
            local delta = enemySpawn.Position - playerSpawn.Position
            local horizontalDistance = Vector2.new(delta.X, delta.Z).Magnitude
            if horizontalDistance <= 200 then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("%s is not spawn-safe from %s", enemySpawn.Id, playerSpawn.Id))
            end
        end
    end

    return #errors == 0, errors
end

local function validateWorld(root: Instance): (boolean, { string })
    local errors: { string } = {}
    if root.Name ~= "GameWorld" or not root:IsA("Model") then
        table.insert(errors, "world root must be the GameWorld Model")
        return false, errors
    end

    for _, path in ipairs(RequiredFolders) do
        if findAtPath(root, path) == nil then
            table.insert(errors, "missing required world path: " .. path)
        end
    end

    local ground = findAtPath(root, StableGround.Path)
    if ground == nil or ground.ClassName ~= StableGround.ClassName then
        table.insert(errors, "StableGround must be a Part")
    elseif ground:IsA("BasePart") then
        if not near(ground.Position, StableGround.Position) or not near(ground.Size, StableGround.Size) then
            table.insert(errors, "StableGround position or size differs from the manifest")
        end
        if not ground.Anchored or not ground.CanCollide then
            table.insert(errors, "StableGround must be anchored and collidable")
        end
    end

    local function validateRecord(record: any, idAttribute: string, extraAttributes: { [string]: any })
        local instance = findAtPath(root, record.Path)
        if instance == nil then
            table.insert(errors, "missing manifest instance: " .. record.Path)
            return
        end
        if instance.ClassName ~= record.ClassName then
            table.insert(errors, string.format("%s must be %s", record.Path, record.ClassName))
        end
        if instance:GetAttribute(idAttribute) ~= record.Id then
            table.insert(errors, string.format("%s has an invalid %s", record.Path, idAttribute))
        end
        for attributeName, expected in pairs(extraAttributes) do
            if instance:GetAttribute(attributeName) ~= expected then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("%s has an invalid %s", record.Path, attributeName))
            end
        end
        local position = getPosition(instance)
        if position == nil or not near(position, record.Position) then
            table.insert(errors, record.Path .. " is not at its manifest position")
        end
    end

    for _, spawn in ipairs(Spawns) do
        validateRecord(spawn, "SpawnId", {
            SpawnRole = spawn.SpawnRole,
            SlotIndex = spawn.SlotIndex,
        })
        local instance = findAtPath(root, spawn.Path)
        if instance ~= nil and instance:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
            if not near(instance.Size, spawn.Size)
                or not instance.Anchored
                or instance.CanCollide
                or instance.Transparency ~= 1
                or not instance.Neutral
                or not instance.Enabled
                or instance.Duration ~= 0
            then
                table.insert(errors, spawn.Path .. " violates the SpawnLocation contract")
            end
        end
    end

    for _, station in ipairs(Stations) do
        local idAttribute = if station.Id == "food_processor" then "ProcessorId" else "InteractionId"
        validateRecord(station, idAttribute, { InteractionKind = station.InteractionKind })
    end
    for _, plot in ipairs(Plots) do
        validateRecord(plot, "PlotId", { InteractionKind = plot.InteractionKind })
    end
    for _, resource in ipairs(Trees) do
        validateRecord(resource, "ResourceNodeId", { ResourceDefinitionId = resource.ResourceDefinitionId })
    end
    for _, resource in ipairs(ScrapCaches) do
        validateRecord(resource, "ResourceNodeId", { ResourceDefinitionId = resource.ResourceDefinitionId })
    end
    for _, enemySpawn in ipairs(EnemySpawns) do
        validateRecord(enemySpawn, "SpawnId", { SpawnGroupId = enemySpawn.SpawnGroupId })
    end
    for _, objective in ipairs(Objectives) do
        validateRecord(objective, "ObjectiveId", {})
    end

    return #errors == 0, errors
end

local function getInteractionKind(interactionId: unknown): Definitions.InteractionKind?
    if type(interactionId) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    return InteractionKindById[interactionId]
end

local function getUpgradeId(interactionId: unknown): Definitions.UpgradeId?
    if type(interactionId) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local station = StationById[interactionId]
    return if station ~= nil then station.UpgradeId else nil
end

local function buildIndex<T>(records: { T }): { [string]: T }
    local result: { [string]: T } = {}
    for _, record in ipairs(records) do
        local dynamicRecord = record :: any
        result[dynamicRecord.Id] = record
    end
    return result
end

local function cloneRecord<T>(record: T): T
    local result = {} :: any
    for key, value in pairs(record :: any) do
        result[key] = value
    end
    return result :: T
end

local function copyRecords<T>(records: { T }): { T }
    local result: { T } = {}
    for index, record in ipairs(records) do
        result[index] = cloneRecord(record)
    end
    return result
end

local function findAtPath(root: Instance, path: string): Instance?
    local current: Instance? = root
    for segment in string.gmatch(path, "[^%.]+") do
        if current == nil then
            return nil
        end
        current = current:FindFirstChild(segment)
    end
    return current
end

local function getPosition(instance: Instance): Vector3?
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        return instance.Position
    end
    if instance:IsA("Model") then
        return instance:GetPivot().Position
    end
    return nil
end

local function near(left: Vector3, right: Vector3): boolean
    return (left - right).Magnitude <= 0.05
end

local function validateManifest(): (boolean, { string })
    local errors: { string } = {}

    if #Spawns ~= Config.Server.MaxActivePlayers then
        table.insert(errors, "spawn count must equal maximum active players")
    end
    if #Plots ~= 12 or #Trees ~= 18 or #ScrapCaches ~= 6 or #Stations ~= 8 or #EnemySpawns ~= 7 then
        table.insert(errors, "one or more frozen world counts changed")
    end
    if StableGround.Position.Y + StableGround.Size.Y / 2 ~= StableGround.TopY then
        table.insert(errors, "stable ground top does not equal the world datum surface")
    end

    local paths: { [string]: boolean } = {}
    local function addRecords(records: { any }, idField: string)
        local ids: { [string]: boolean } = {}
        for _, record in ipairs(records) do
            if record.Id ~= record[idField] then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("manifest aliases disagree for %s", tostring(record.Id)))
            elseif ids[record[idField]] then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("duplicate manifest %s: %s", idField, record[idField]))
            end
            ids[record[idField]] = true
            if paths[record.Path] then
                table.insert(errors, "duplicate manifest path: " .. record.Path)
            end
            paths[record.Path] = true
        end
    end
    addRecords(Spawns, "SpawnId")
    addRecords(Stations, "InteractionId")
    addRecords(Plots, "PlotId")
    addRecords(ResourceNodes, "ResourceNodeId")
    addRecords(EnemySpawns, "SpawnId")
    addRecords(Objectives, "ObjectiveId")

    for _, enemySpawn in ipairs(EnemySpawns) do
        for _, playerSpawn in ipairs(Spawns) do
            local delta = enemySpawn.Position - playerSpawn.Position
            local horizontalDistance = Vector2.new(delta.X, delta.Z).Magnitude
            if horizontalDistance <= 200 then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("%s is not spawn-safe from %s", enemySpawn.Id, playerSpawn.Id))
            end
        end
    end

    return #errors == 0, errors
end

local function validateWorld(root: Instance): (boolean, { string })
    local errors: { string } = {}
    if root.Name ~= "GameWorld" or not root:IsA("Model") then
        table.insert(errors, "world root must be the GameWorld Model")
        return false, errors
    end

    for _, path in ipairs(RequiredFolders) do
        if findAtPath(root, path) == nil then
            table.insert(errors, "missing required world path: " .. path)
        end
    end

    local ground = findAtPath(root, StableGround.Path)
    if ground == nil or ground.ClassName ~= StableGround.ClassName then
        table.insert(errors, "StableGround must be a Part")
    elseif ground:IsA("BasePart") then
        if not near(ground.Position, StableGround.Position) or not near(ground.Size, StableGround.Size) then
            table.insert(errors, "StableGround position or size differs from the manifest")
        end
        if not ground.Anchored or not ground.CanCollide then
            table.insert(errors, "StableGround must be anchored and collidable")
        end
    end

    local function validateRecord(record: any, idAttribute: string, extraAttributes: { [string]: any })
        local instance = findAtPath(root, record.Path)
        if instance == nil then
            table.insert(errors, "missing manifest instance: " .. record.Path)
            return
        end
        if instance.ClassName ~= record.ClassName then
            table.insert(errors, string.format("%s must be %s", record.Path, record.ClassName))
        end
        if instance:GetAttribute(idAttribute) ~= record.Id then
            table.insert(errors, string.format("%s has an invalid %s", record.Path, idAttribute))
        end
        for attributeName, expected in pairs(extraAttributes) do
            if instance:GetAttribute(attributeName) ~= expected then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("%s has an invalid %s", record.Path, attributeName))
            end
        end
        local position = getPosition(instance)
        if position == nil or not near(position, record.Position) then
            table.insert(errors, record.Path .. " is not at its manifest position")
        end
    end

    for _, spawn in ipairs(Spawns) do
        validateRecord(spawn, "SpawnId", {
            SpawnRole = spawn.SpawnRole,
            SlotIndex = spawn.SlotIndex,
        })
        local instance = findAtPath(root, spawn.Path)
        if instance ~= nil and instance:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
            if not near(instance.Size, spawn.Size)
                or not instance.Anchored
                or instance.CanCollide
                or instance.Transparency ~= 1
                or not instance.Neutral
                or not instance.Enabled
                or instance.Duration ~= 0
            then
                table.insert(errors, spawn.Path .. " violates the SpawnLocation contract")
            end
        end
    end

    for _, station in ipairs(Stations) do
        local idAttribute = if station.Id == "food_processor" then "ProcessorId" else "InteractionId"
        validateRecord(station, idAttribute, { InteractionKind = station.InteractionKind })
    end
    for _, plot in ipairs(Plots) do
        validateRecord(plot, "PlotId", { InteractionKind = plot.InteractionKind })
    end
    for _, resource in ipairs(Trees) do
        validateRecord(resource, "ResourceNodeId", { ResourceDefinitionId = resource.ResourceDefinitionId })
    end
    for _, resource in ipairs(ScrapCaches) do
        validateRecord(resource, "ResourceNodeId", { ResourceDefinitionId = resource.ResourceDefinitionId })
    end
    for _, enemySpawn in ipairs(EnemySpawns) do
        validateRecord(enemySpawn, "SpawnId", { SpawnGroupId = enemySpawn.SpawnGroupId })
    end
    for _, objective in ipairs(Objectives) do
        validateRecord(objective, "ObjectiveId", {})
    end

    return #errors == 0, errors
end

local function getInteractionKind(interactionId: unknown): Definitions.InteractionKind?
    if type(interactionId) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    return InteractionKindById[interactionId]
end

local function getUpgradeId(interactionId: unknown): Definitions.UpgradeId?
    if type(interactionId) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local station = StationById[interactionId]
    return if station ~= nil then station.UpgradeId else nil
end

local function buildIndex<T>(records: { T }): { [string]: T }
    local result: { [string]: T } = {}
    for _, record in ipairs(records) do
        local dynamicRecord = record :: any
        result[dynamicRecord.Id] = record
    end
    return result
end

local SpawnById = buildIndex(Spawns)
local StationById = buildIndex(Stations)
local PlotById = buildIndex(Plots)
local TreeById = buildIndex(Trees)
local ScrapCacheById = buildIndex(ScrapCaches)
local EnemySpawnById = buildIndex(EnemySpawns)
local ObjectiveById = buildIndex(Objectives)

local InteractionKindById: { [string]: Definitions.InteractionKind } = {}
for _, station in ipairs(Stations) do
    InteractionKindById[station.Id] = station.InteractionKind
end
for _, plot in ipairs(Plots) do
    InteractionKindById[plot.Id] = plot.InteractionKind
end

local function cloneRecord<T>(record: T): T
    local result = {} :: any
    for key, value in pairs(record :: any) do
        result[key] = value
    end
    return result :: T
end

local function copyRecords<T>(records: { T }): { T }
    local result: { T } = {}
    for index, record in ipairs(records) do
        result[index] = cloneRecord(record)
    end
    return result
end

local function findAtPath(root: Instance, path: string): Instance?
    local current: Instance? = root
    for segment in string.gmatch(path, "[^%.]+") do
        if current == nil then
            return nil
        end
        current = current:FindFirstChild(segment)
    end
    return current
end

local function getPosition(instance: Instance): Vector3?
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        return instance.Position
    end
    if instance:IsA("Model") then
        return instance:GetPivot().Position
    end
    return nil
end

local function near(left: Vector3, right: Vector3): boolean
    return (left - right).Magnitude <= 0.05
end

local function validateManifest(): (boolean, { string })
    local errors: { string } = {}

    if #Spawns ~= Config.Server.MaxActivePlayers then
        table.insert(errors, "spawn count must equal maximum active players")
    end
    if #Plots ~= 12 or #Trees ~= 18 or #ScrapCaches ~= 6 or #Stations ~= 8 or #EnemySpawns ~= 7 then
        table.insert(errors, "one or more frozen world counts changed")
    end
    if StableGround.Position.Y + StableGround.Size.Y / 2 ~= StableGround.TopY then
        table.insert(errors, "stable ground top does not equal the world datum surface")
    end

    local paths: { [string]: boolean } = {}
    local function addRecords(records: { any }, idField: string)
        local ids: { [string]: boolean } = {}
        for _, record in ipairs(records) do
            if record.Id ~= record[idField] then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("manifest aliases disagree for %s", tostring(record.Id)))
            elseif ids[record[idField]] then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("duplicate manifest %s: %s", idField, record[idField]))
            end
            ids[record[idField]] = true
            if paths[record.Path] then
                table.insert(errors, "duplicate manifest path: " .. record.Path)
            end
            paths[record.Path] = true
        end
    end
    addRecords(Spawns, "SpawnId")
    addRecords(Stations, "InteractionId")
    addRecords(Plots, "PlotId")
    addRecords(ResourceNodes, "ResourceNodeId")
    addRecords(EnemySpawns, "SpawnId")
    addRecords(Objectives, "ObjectiveId")

    for _, enemySpawn in ipairs(EnemySpawns) do
        for _, playerSpawn in ipairs(Spawns) do
            local delta = enemySpawn.Position - playerSpawn.Position
            local horizontalDistance = Vector2.new(delta.X, delta.Z).Magnitude
            if horizontalDistance <= 200 then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("%s is not spawn-safe from %s", enemySpawn.Id, playerSpawn.Id))
            end
        end
    end

    return #errors == 0, errors
end

local function validateWorld(root: Instance): (boolean, { string })
    local errors: { string } = {}
    if root.Name ~= "GameWorld" or not root:IsA("Model") then
        table.insert(errors, "world root must be the GameWorld Model")
        return false, errors
    end

    for _, path in ipairs(RequiredFolders) do
        if findAtPath(root, path) == nil then
            table.insert(errors, "missing required world path: " .. path)
        end
    end

    local ground = findAtPath(root, StableGround.Path)
    if ground == nil or ground.ClassName ~= StableGround.ClassName then
        table.insert(errors, "StableGround must be a Part")
    elseif ground:IsA("BasePart") then
        if not near(ground.Position, StableGround.Position) or not near(ground.Size, StableGround.Size) then
            table.insert(errors, "StableGround position or size differs from the manifest")
        end
        if not ground.Anchored or not ground.CanCollide then
            table.insert(errors, "StableGround must be anchored and collidable")
        end
    end

    local function validateRecord(record: any, idAttribute: string, extraAttributes: { [string]: any })
        local instance = findAtPath(root, record.Path)
        if instance == nil then
            table.insert(errors, "missing manifest instance: " .. record.Path)
            return
        end
        if instance.ClassName ~= record.ClassName then
            table.insert(errors, string.format("%s must be %s", record.Path, record.ClassName))
        end
        if instance:GetAttribute(idAttribute) ~= record.Id then
            table.insert(errors, string.format("%s has an invalid %s", record.Path, idAttribute))
        end
        for attributeName, expected in pairs(extraAttributes) do
            if instance:GetAttribute(attributeName) ~= expected then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("%s has an invalid %s", record.Path, attributeName))
            end
        end
        local position = getPosition(instance)
        if position == nil or not near(position, record.Position) then
            table.insert(errors, record.Path .. " is not at its manifest position")
        end
    end

    for _, spawn in ipairs(Spawns) do
        validateRecord(spawn, "SpawnId", {
            SpawnRole = spawn.SpawnRole,
            SlotIndex = spawn.SlotIndex,
        })
        local instance = findAtPath(root, spawn.Path)
        if instance ~= nil and instance:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
            if not near(instance.Size, spawn.Size)
                or not instance.Anchored
                or instance.CanCollide
                or instance.Transparency ~= 1
                or not instance.Neutral
                or not instance.Enabled
                or instance.Duration ~= 0
            then
                table.insert(errors, spawn.Path .. " violates the SpawnLocation contract")
            end
        end
    end

    for _, station in ipairs(Stations) do
        local idAttribute = if station.Id == "food_processor" then "ProcessorId" else "InteractionId"
        validateRecord(station, idAttribute, { InteractionKind = station.InteractionKind })
    end
    for _, plot in ipairs(Plots) do
        validateRecord(plot, "PlotId", { InteractionKind = plot.InteractionKind })
    end
    for _, resource in ipairs(Trees) do
        validateRecord(resource, "ResourceNodeId", { ResourceDefinitionId = resource.ResourceDefinitionId })
    end
    for _, resource in ipairs(ScrapCaches) do
        validateRecord(resource, "ResourceNodeId", { ResourceDefinitionId = resource.ResourceDefinitionId })
    end
    for _, enemySpawn in ipairs(EnemySpawns) do
        validateRecord(enemySpawn, "SpawnId", { SpawnGroupId = enemySpawn.SpawnGroupId })
    end
    for _, objective in ipairs(Objectives) do
        validateRecord(objective, "ObjectiveId", {})
    end

    return #errors == 0, errors
end

local function getInteractionKind(interactionId: unknown): Definitions.InteractionKind?
    if type(interactionId) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    return InteractionKindById[interactionId]
end

local function getUpgradeId(interactionId: unknown): Definitions.UpgradeId?
    if type(interactionId) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local station = StationById[interactionId]
    return if station ~= nil then station.UpgradeId else nil
end

local function buildIndex<T>(records: { T }): { [string]: T }
    local result: { [string]: T } = {}
    for _, record in ipairs(records) do
        local dynamicRecord = record :: any
        result[dynamicRecord.Id] = record
    end
    return result
end

for _, plot in ipairs(Plots) do

local function cloneRecord<T>(record: T): T
    local result = {} :: any
    for key, value in pairs(record :: any) do
        result[key] = value
    end
    return result :: T
end

local function copyRecords<T>(records: { T }): { T }
    local result: { T } = {}
    for index, record in ipairs(records) do
        result[index] = cloneRecord(record)
    end
    return result
end

local function findAtPath(root: Instance, path: string): Instance?
    local current: Instance? = root
    for segment in string.gmatch(path, "[^%.]+") do
        if current == nil then
            return nil
        end
        current = current:FindFirstChild(segment)
    end
    return current
end

local function getPosition(instance: Instance): Vector3?
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        return instance.Position
    end
    if instance:IsA("Model") then
        return instance:GetPivot().Position
    end
    return nil
end

local function near(left: Vector3, right: Vector3): boolean
    return (left - right).Magnitude <= 0.05
end

local function validateManifest(): (boolean, { string })
    local errors: { string } = {}

    if #Spawns ~= Config.Server.MaxActivePlayers then
        table.insert(errors, "spawn count must equal maximum active players")
    end
    if #Plots ~= 12 or #Trees ~= 18 or #ScrapCaches ~= 6 or #Stations ~= 8 or #EnemySpawns ~= 7 then
        table.insert(errors, "one or more frozen world counts changed")
    end
    if StableGround.Position.Y + StableGround.Size.Y / 2 ~= StableGround.TopY then
        table.insert(errors, "stable ground top does not equal the world datum surface")
    end

    local paths: { [string]: boolean } = {}
    local function addRecords(records: { any }, idField: string)
        local ids: { [string]: boolean } = {}
        for _, record in ipairs(records) do
            if record.Id ~= record[idField] then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("manifest aliases disagree for %s", tostring(record.Id)))
            elseif ids[record[idField]] then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("duplicate manifest %s: %s", idField, record[idField]))
            end
            ids[record[idField]] = true
            if paths[record.Path] then
                table.insert(errors, "duplicate manifest path: " .. record.Path)
            end
            paths[record.Path] = true
        end
    end
    addRecords(Spawns, "SpawnId")
    addRecords(Stations, "InteractionId")
    addRecords(Plots, "PlotId")
    addRecords(ResourceNodes, "ResourceNodeId")
    addRecords(EnemySpawns, "SpawnId")
    addRecords(Objectives, "ObjectiveId")

    for _, enemySpawn in ipairs(EnemySpawns) do
        for _, playerSpawn in ipairs(Spawns) do
            local delta = enemySpawn.Position - playerSpawn.Position
            local horizontalDistance = Vector2.new(delta.X, delta.Z).Magnitude
            if horizontalDistance <= 200 then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("%s is not spawn-safe from %s", enemySpawn.Id, playerSpawn.Id))
            end
        end
    end

    return #errors == 0, errors
end

local function validateWorld(root: Instance): (boolean, { string })
    local errors: { string } = {}
    if root.Name ~= "GameWorld" or not root:IsA("Model") then
        table.insert(errors, "world root must be the GameWorld Model")
        return false, errors
    end

    for _, path in ipairs(RequiredFolders) do
        if findAtPath(root, path) == nil then
            table.insert(errors, "missing required world path: " .. path)
        end
    end

    local ground = findAtPath(root, StableGround.Path)
    if ground == nil or ground.ClassName ~= StableGround.ClassName then
        table.insert(errors, "StableGround must be a Part")
    elseif ground:IsA("BasePart") then
        if not near(ground.Position, StableGround.Position) or not near(ground.Size, StableGround.Size) then
            table.insert(errors, "StableGround position or size differs from the manifest")
        end
        if not ground.Anchored or not ground.CanCollide then
            table.insert(errors, "StableGround must be anchored and collidable")
        end
    end

    local function validateRecord(record: any, idAttribute: string, extraAttributes: { [string]: any })
        local instance = findAtPath(root, record.Path)
        if instance == nil then
            table.insert(errors, "missing manifest instance: " .. record.Path)
            return
        end
        if instance.ClassName ~= record.ClassName then
            table.insert(errors, string.format("%s must be %s", record.Path, record.ClassName))
        end
        if instance:GetAttribute(idAttribute) ~= record.Id then
            table.insert(errors, string.format("%s has an invalid %s", record.Path, idAttribute))
        end
        for attributeName, expected in pairs(extraAttributes) do
            if instance:GetAttribute(attributeName) ~= expected then
                table.insert(errors, string.format("%s has an invalid %s", record.Path, attributeName))
            end
        end
        local position = getPosition(instance)
        if position == nil or not near(position, record.Position) then
            table.insert(errors, record.Path .. " is not at its manifest position")
        end
    end

    for _, spawn in ipairs(Spawns) do
        validateRecord(spawn, "SpawnId", {
            SpawnRole = spawn.SpawnRole,
            SlotIndex = spawn.SlotIndex,
        })
        local instance = findAtPath(root, spawn.Path)
        if instance ~= nil and instance:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
            if not near(instance.Size, spawn.Size)
                or not instance.Anchored
                or instance.CanCollide
                or instance.Transparency ~= 1
                or not instance.Neutral
                or not instance.Enabled
                or instance.Duration ~= 0
            then
                table.insert(errors, spawn.Path .. " violates the SpawnLocation contract")
            end
        end
    end

    for _, station in ipairs(Stations) do
        local idAttribute = if station.Id == "food_processor" then "ProcessorId" else "InteractionId"
        validateRecord(station, idAttribute, { InteractionKind = station.InteractionKind })
    end
    for _, plot in ipairs(Plots) do
        validateRecord(plot, "PlotId", { InteractionKind = plot.InteractionKind })
    end
    for _, resource in ipairs(Trees) do
        validateRecord(resource, "ResourceNodeId", { ResourceDefinitionId = resource.ResourceDefinitionId })
    end
    for _, resource in ipairs(ScrapCaches) do
        validateRecord(resource, "ResourceNodeId", { ResourceDefinitionId = resource.ResourceDefinitionId })
    end
    for _, enemySpawn in ipairs(EnemySpawns) do
        validateRecord(enemySpawn, "SpawnId", { SpawnGroupId = enemySpawn.SpawnGroupId })
    end
    for _, objective in ipairs(Objectives) do
        validateRecord(objective, "ObjectiveId", {})
    end

    return #errors == 0, errors
end

end

set -u

ROOT="/Users/Ori/Documents/Projects/BunkerGame"
RUNROOT="$ROOT/.opencode/overnight_world_v2"

export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:$HOME/.aftman/bin:$PATH"

CP="${1:-UNKNOWN}"
STATUS="${2:-INFO}"
shift 2 2>/dev/null || true
MESSAGE="$*"

TS="$(/bin/date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
SAFE_CP="$(printf '%s' "$CP" | /usr/bin/tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9._-')"

printf '%s|%s|%s|%s\n' \
  "$TS" \
  "$SAFE_CP" \
  "$STATUS" \
  "$MESSAGE" \
  >> "$RUNROOT/events.log"

printf '%s\n' "$SAFE_CP" > "$RUNROOT/current_checkpoint.txt"
printf '%s\n' "$MESSAGE" > "$RUNROOT/current_activity.txt"

if [ "$STATUS" = "START" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$SAFE_CP" > "$RUNROOT/state.txt"
fi

if [ "$STATUS" = "PASS" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$SAFE_CP" > "$RUNROOT/last_passed_checkpoint.txt"

  SNAP="$RUNROOT/checkpoints/${SAFE_CP}_$(/bin/date '+%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')"

  /bin/mkdir -p "$SNAP"

  if [ -d "$ROOT/src" ]; then
    /usr/bin/tar -czf "$SNAP/src.tar.gz" -C "$ROOT" src 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

  if [ -f "$ROOT/default.project.json" ]; then
    /bin/cp "$ROOT/default.project.json" "$SNAP/default.project.json" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

  if [ -f "$ROOT/opencode.json" ]; then
    /bin/cp "$ROOT/opencode.json" "$SNAP/opencode.json" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

  if [ -d "$ROOT/src/ServerStorage/GeneratedAssets" ]; then
    /usr/bin/find "$ROOT/src/ServerStorage/GeneratedAssets" \
      -type f \
      -print \
      | /usr/bin/sort \
      > "$SNAP/generated_assets.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

  /usr/bin/find "$ROOT/src" \
    -type f \
    -print \
    2>/dev/null \
    | /usr/bin/sort \
    > "$SNAP/source_files.txt" || true

  printf '%s\n' "$MESSAGE" > "$SNAP/checkpoint.txt"
  printf '%s\n' "$TS" >> "$SNAP/checkpoint.txt"
fi

printf 'CHECKPOINT|%s|%s|%s\n' "$SAFE_CP" "$STATUS" "$MESSAGE"

set -u

ROOT="/Users/Ori/Documents/Projects/BunkerGame"
RUNROOT="$ROOT/.opencode/overnight_world_v2"

export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:$HOME/.aftman/bin:$PATH"

CP="${1:-UNKNOWN}"
STATUS="${2:-INFO}"
shift 2 2>/dev/null || true
MESSAGE="$*"

TS="$(/bin/date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"

printf '%s|%s|%s|%s\n' \
  "$TS" \
  "$SAFE_CP" \
  "$STATUS" \
  "$MESSAGE" \
  >> "$RUNROOT/events.log"

printf '%s\n' "$MESSAGE" > "$RUNROOT/current_activity.txt"

if [ "$STATUS" = "START" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$SAFE_CP" > "$RUNROOT/state.txt"
fi

if [ "$STATUS" = "PASS" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$SAFE_CP" > "$RUNROOT/last_passed_checkpoint.txt"

  SNAP="$RUNROOT/checkpoints/${SAFE_CP}_$(/bin/date '+%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')"

  /bin/mkdir -p "$SNAP"

  if [ -d "$ROOT/src" ]; then
    /usr/bin/tar -czf "$SNAP/src.tar.gz" -C "$ROOT" src 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

  if [ -f "$ROOT/default.project.json" ]; then
    /bin/cp "$ROOT/default.project.json" "$SNAP/default.project.json" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

  if [ -f "$ROOT/opencode.json" ]; then
    /bin/cp "$ROOT/opencode.json" "$SNAP/opencode.json" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

  if [ -d "$ROOT/src/ServerStorage/GeneratedAssets" ]; then
    /usr/bin/find "$ROOT/src/ServerStorage/GeneratedAssets" \
      -type f \
      -print \
      | /usr/bin/sort \
      > "$SNAP/generated_assets.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi

  /usr/bin/find "$ROOT/src" \
    -type f \
    -print \
    2>/dev/null \
    | /usr/bin/sort \
    > "$SNAP/source_files.txt" || true

  printf '%s\n' "$MESSAGE" > "$SNAP/checkpoint.txt"
  printf '%s\n' "$TS" >> "$SNAP/checkpoint.txt"
fi

printf 'CHECKPOINT|%s|%s|%s\n' "$SAFE_CP" "$STATUS" "$MESSAGE"

--!strict

local ServiceBag = {}
ServiceBag.__index = ServiceBag

export type Service = {
	Init: (self: Service, bag: ServiceBag) -> (),
	Start: (self: Service) -> (),
	Stop: (self: Service) -> (),
}

export type ServiceBag = typeof(setmetatable({} :: {
	Context: { [string]: any },
	_services: { [string]: Service },
	_order: { { Name: string, Service: Service } },
	_initializedCount: number,
	_started: boolean,
	_stopping: boolean,
}, ServiceBag))

function ServiceBag.new(context: { [string]: any }): ServiceBag
	return setmetatable({
		Context = context,
		_services = {},
		_order = {},
		_initializedCount = 0,
		_started = false,
		_stopping = false,
	}, ServiceBag)
end

function ServiceBag.Add(self: ServiceBag, name: string, service: any): any
	assert(not self._started and self._initializedCount == 0, "services must be registered before initialization")
	assert(type(name) == "string" and name ~= "", "service name must be non-empty")
	assert(self._services[name] == nil, string.format("duplicate service %s", name))
	assert(type(service) == "table", string.format("service %s must be a table", name))
	assert(type(service.Init) == "function", string.format("service %s has no Init", name))
	assert(type(service.Start) == "function", string.format("service %s has no Start", name))
	assert(type(service.Stop) == "function", string.format("service %s has no Stop", name))

	self._services[name] = service
	table.insert(self._order, {
		Name = name,
		Service = service,
	})
	return service
end

function ServiceBag.Get(self: ServiceBag, name: string): any
	local service = self._services[name]
	assert(service ~= nil, string.format("unknown service %s", name))
	return service
end

function ServiceBag.IsStopping(self: ServiceBag): boolean
	return self._stopping
end

function ServiceBag.Init(self: ServiceBag)
	if self._initializedCount == #self._order then
		return
	end
	assert(self._initializedCount == 0, "partial service initialization cannot be resumed")

	for index, entry in ipairs(self._order) do
		-- Include the current service in rollback even when Init only partially completes.
		self._initializedCount = index
		local ok, err = xpcall(function()
			entry.Service:Init(self)
		end, debug.traceback)
		if not ok then
			self:Stop()
			error(string.format("service %s Init failed: %s", entry.Name, tostring(err)), 0)
		end
	end
end

function ServiceBag.Start(self: ServiceBag)
	if self._started then
		return
	end
	assert(self._initializedCount == #self._order, "all services must initialize before Start")

	for _, entry in ipairs(self._order) do
		local ok, err = xpcall(function()
			entry.Service:Start()
		end, debug.traceback)
		if not ok then
			self:Stop()
			error(string.format("service %s Start failed: %s", entry.Name, tostring(err)), 0)
		end
	end
	self._started = true
end

function ServiceBag.Stop(self: ServiceBag)
	if self._stopping then
		return
	end
	if self._initializedCount == 0 then
		self._started = false
		return
	end

	self._stopping = true
	for index = self._initializedCount, 1, -1 do
		local entry = self._order[index]
		local ok, err = xpcall(function()
			entry.Service:Stop()
		end, debug.traceback)
		if not ok then
			warn(string.format("service %s Stop failed: %s", entry.Name, tostring(err)))
		end
	end
	self._initializedCount = 0
	self._started = false
	self._stopping = false
end

return ServiceBag

--!strict

local ServiceBag = {}
ServiceBag.__index = ServiceBag

export type Service = {
	Init: (self: Service, bag: ServiceBag) -> (),
	Start: (self: Service) -> (),
	Stop: (self: Service) -> (),
}

export type ServiceBag = typeof(setmetatable({} :: {
	Context: { [string]: any },
	_services: { [string]: Service },
	_order: { { Name: string, Service: Service } },
	_initializedCount: number,
	_started: boolean,
	_stopping: boolean,
}, ServiceBag))

function ServiceBag.new(context: { [string]: any }): ServiceBag
	return setmetatable({
		Context = context,
		_services = {},
		_order = {},
		_initializedCount = 0,
		_started = false,
		_stopping = false,
	}, ServiceBag)
end

function ServiceBag.Add(self: ServiceBag, name: string, service: any): any
	assert(not self._started and self._initializedCount == 0, "services must be registered before initialization")
	assert(type(name) == "string" and name ~= "", "service name must be non-empty")
	assert(self._services[name] == nil, string.format("duplicate service %s", name))
	assert(type(service) == "table", string.format("service %s must be a table", name))
	assert(type(service.Init) == "function", string.format("service %s has no Init", name))
	assert(type(service.Start) == "function", string.format("service %s has no Start", name))
	assert(type(service.Stop) == "function", string.format("service %s has no Stop", name))

	self._services[name] = service
	table.insert(self._order, {
		Name = name,
		Service = service,
	})
	return service
end

function ServiceBag.Get(self: ServiceBag, name: string): any
	local service = self._services[name]
	assert(service ~= nil, string.format("unknown service %s", name))
	return service
end

function ServiceBag.IsStopping(self: ServiceBag): boolean
	return self._stopping
end

function ServiceBag.Init(self: ServiceBag)
	if self._initializedCount == #self._order then
		return
	end
	assert(self._initializedCount == 0, "partial service initialization cannot be resumed")

	for index, entry in ipairs(self._order) do
		-- Include the current service in rollback even when Init only partially completes.
		self._initializedCount = index
		local ok, err = xpcall(function()
			entry.Service:Init(self)
		end, debug.traceback)
		if not ok then
			self:Stop()
			error(string.format("service %s Init failed: %s", entry.Name, tostring(err)), 0)
		end
	end
end

function ServiceBag.Start(self: ServiceBag)
	if self._started then
		return
	end
	assert(self._initializedCount == #self._order, "all services must initialize before Start")

	for _, entry in ipairs(self._order) do
		local ok, err = xpcall(function()
			entry.Service:Start()
		end, debug.traceback)
		if not ok then
			self:Stop()
			error(string.format("service %s Start failed: %s", entry.Name, tostring(err)), 0)
		end
	end
	self._started = true
end

function ServiceBag.Stop(self: ServiceBag)
	if self._stopping then
		return
	end
	if self._initializedCount == 0 then
		self._started = false
		return
	end

	self._stopping = true
	for index = self._initializedCount, 1, -1 do
		local entry = self._order[index]
		local ok, err = xpcall(function()
			entry.Service:Stop()
		end, debug.traceback)
		if not ok then
			warn(string.format("service %s Stop failed: %s", entry.Name, tostring(err)))
		end
	end
	self._initializedCount = 0
	self._started = false
	self._stopping = false
end

return ServiceBag
